3321.title: Workflow activity and worker visibility
3321.rootCauseOneLine: Workflow workers spawn hidden without a parent; core workflow activity counts background-task events rather than plugin run records.
3321.proposedFix: Resolve the explicit hidden-worker product policy before changing visibility, then verify a lifecycle integration for origin activity.
3321.caveats: SDK-boundary behavior repeated in two clean checkouts. Live UI and origin runtime unverified. Full build stopped; the existing broad integration test timed out. Complete test and assertion output are inline in the report.
